title: tracker-write.ts's encodeTickRecord has the same Go-escaping divergence the corpus just fixed in the client
body: cloudflare/src/tracker-write.ts has a SECOND tick-record encoder with its own JSON.stringify, so every create it commits over a title, description or acceptance_criteria containing & < > (or U+2028) writes bytes tk would not — its docstring claims byte-identity with Store.Write, which is false for those bytes. Out of this tick's scope (the acceptance names the tracker client); the repair is to share the client's goEscape and extend the tk corpus to certify creates: internal/tkcorpus already pins 10 real tk creates that would replay through encodeTickRecord.
